key_insight: AlgMortar turns a multiscale mortar preconditioner into a fully algebraic, matrix-only method that can efficiently accelerate Krylov solvers for heterogeneous elliptic systems.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical preconditioning strategy for large, ill-conditioned flow and porous-media simulations where standard solvers struggle with high-contrast coefficients.
method: Partition the matrix graph into subdomains using graph partitioning.
Solve local Dirichlet-like problems on each subdomain using only fine-grid matrix information.
Couple subdomain solutions with an algebraic interface condition that enforces weak flux continuity.
evidence_signal: In Darcy-flow finite-volume tests, AlgMortar used as a CG preconditioner showed good scalability and competitive performance versus state-of-the-art algebraic multigrid, including difficult high-contrast and irregular corner-point grids.
watch_item: The method’s well-posedness is proved under SPD matrices with nonpositive off-diagonal entries, so performance and guarantees may be more limited outside this matrix class.
paper_title: AlgMortar: a fully algebraic multiscale mortar preconditioner
